data.title: bn-240: Add optional draw-event tracing for visual isolation

data.body: HIGH: Trace camera resolution diverges from the renderer for a legal i32::MIN camera. The renderer uses x.saturating_sub(cam), but saturating_neg(MIN) loses one before translation: camera(-2147483648,-2147483648); pset(-2147483648,-2147483648,1) paints framebuffer (0,0), while draw_events reports screen_bounds (-1,-1) and no visible_bounds. Compute x - camera in widened arithmetic (then clamp) so the trace uses the renderer's exact transform, and add this boundary regression.

HIGH: Bounds cannot represent the full inclusive span of two legal i32 endpoints: corners() clamps width/height to i32::MAX. rectfill(-2147483648,0,2147483647,0,1) paints the visible screen, but the trace serializes x=-2147483648,w=2147483647 and visible_bounds=null because that truncated interval ends before x=0. Use a widened bounds representation/arithmetic (or otherwise preserve the true right/bottom edge) and regress visible/clip results for this case.

data.reason: Draw bounds/camera arithmetic disagrees with rendered pixels for legal extreme coordinates, violating the explicit camera/clipping accuracy criterion.

data.body: Fixed in a0b3125: Bounds now stores exact i64 x/y/w/h, inclusive corners preserve the full 4,294,967,296-wide i32 span, and a regression asserts the visible 192-pixel intersection for rectfill(i32::MIN,...,i32::MAX,...). Full just check passes.

Fixed in a0b3125: screen bounds now use renderer-matched transform modes. Origins and endpoints call saturating_sub exactly like DrawState, while widened bounds preserve full spans. Regressions cover camera(MIN)+pset(MIN) resolving to visible (0,0), full-range corners, and sprite origin saturation. Full just check passes.

data.reason: Fixed and regression-tested in a0b3125; verified during re-review.

data.body: HIGH: map draw bounds still truncate legal scaled ranges before the widened Bounds layer.  clamps  to i32::MAX, even though gfx::map deliberately performs this destination arithmetic in i64. Reproduction: a cart with map cell 0 = tile 1, then map(-268435456,0,-2147483648,0,268435457,1), paints tile 1 at screen (0,0), but draw_events reports screen_bounds x=-2147483648,w=2147483647 and no visible_bounds. Preserve the exact i64 pixel width/height for map bounds (and add this regression) so the new wide representation is used end-to-end.

data.reason: Original boundary findings are fixed, but map() still truncates legal i64-scaled destination bounds and can report a visible rendered tile as wholly offscreen.

data.body: Correction: the truncating helper is scaled(value, factor), which clamps value times factor to i32::MAX. The affected destination bounds are constructed at current api.rs line 548; the review context is anchored to the original diff.

data.reason: Fixed in the current workspace: map pixel extents now retain exact i64 scaling, and the reproduced offset tile has visible_bounds (0,0,8,8). Focused trace tests and workspace clippy pass.
